verdict.rationale: Cooley GO is a web-based document generator, and Cooley AI is a firm-owned AI company, so an official SDK or API is a plausible capability to ask about. Nothing in the evidence documents an official SDK, client library or developer API. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
